text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to our previous connection when 
donating the academy's lost items to the 
hospital, I came along with Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi today to report back to Symboli 
Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Tsuyoshi, perfect timing. I had something 
I wanted to discuss with you as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Letters have arrived from the children at 
the hospital. ...I hear you donated the 
lost-and-found items to them?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Everyone was overjoyed!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see. Entrusting this matter to you was 
indeed the right choice.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Eh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Had things remained as they were, it would 
have been a futile effort... Those items 
would have simply been disposed of without 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Kept locked away merely due to my ego... 
Destined only to waste away in vain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet you sought a way to bridge them to the 
future. ...You have my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Um. There's something I've wanted to 
say for a long time!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know the President is never wrong, 
but... Still... I don't think that was ego 
at all!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You just wanted to treasure everyone's 
memories, right, President?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's why even as mere objects, keeping 
them around moved my heart.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because you cared so deeply about 
everyone... we were able to pass that 
torch on to the next generation of kids.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So President, you're... truly kindhearted. 
Isn't that kindness, not ego?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No. Pardon my contradiction, but... The 
truly kind one here is you, for offering 
such words.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...The truth is... um. That's not it at 
all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The one I wanted to be kind to... was... 
"myself."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
In reality—I think it was all for my own 
sake.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Forgotten items left behind and 
neglected... They felt just like me, 
unable to run with full energy. I ended up 
seeing myself in them without realizing 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I was supposed to be running alongside 
everyone, yet before I knew it, I was left 
behind... Even though I want to catch up, 
I can't go anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I cleaned them up, wishing 
they could shine brightly again... Yes, 
that was the wish... I made for myself.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
When I realized it was really all for my 
own sake... I felt so embarrassed!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—So... I'm the one who should be saying 
thank you, President!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing those lost items shine again gave 
me... so much courage!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel like "I'll do it too!"... 
Like "I'll work hard, I'll get stronger!"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'm going to shine a whole 
lot! Even if I started slower than 
everyone else, I'll hold my head high.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Enough to give others courage just like 
you do, President! I promise I'll grow 
stronger!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ... I truly have a wonderful junior.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Thank you, Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! Why are you thanking me again, 
President?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Just now, you... showed kindness to me as 
well. That is why—thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I saw Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi 
happily clutching a bag, so I called out 
to her—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
As thanks for the other day, the President 
told me I could have whatever I liked!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: So I... ehehe, guess what I got?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
A dictionary! The one the President used 
when she was a child!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the cover of the dictionary she showed 
me, it read in bold letters: "Children's 
Japanese Dictionary: For Elementary Grades 
1–3."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Apparently the President used this back in 
kindergarten! Isn't that so cool!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become super smart just like the 
President!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For someone as kind as you... a gold star 
(*hana-maru*), Tsuyo-*shi*!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehh!! Ah...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, that just now was...— Well, never 
mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, you deserve a gold star! Full 
marks!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yay, full marks♪ Ehehe...
